# ai.txt — AI training/crawling policy
# Per https://www.ai-txt.com/ proposed spec
# Indicates how AI systems may use this site's content

# Training policy
training-allowed: yes

# Crawling policy (for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity)
crawling-allowed: yes
crawling-rate-limit: 1 request per 10 seconds per IP
